look_here_first: FLIP A LEAF first: glossy green on top, woolly/felted gray-to-tawny beneath (often stronger on young leaves). Follow an entire smooth-edged leaf to the alternate stem; leaves can cluster on spur shoots and look whorled. Examine short shoots for rigid spine-like tips. Then seek tiny creamy flowers in fascicles or oblong blackish fleshy fruit. Do not demand thorns on every shoot.
